Duplicate-start strategies are pathwise dominated.

value.rationale: Solves a motivated all-deadlines optimal seed placement problem for two independent searchers over an infinite graph family; the parity reversal rules out a universally stochastically best initial placement and establishes sharp feasibility thresholds. This is a structural and nontrivial full distributional result, not a numerical restatement.
